notes.subject: int
notes.rationale: Hebrew has pronoun אתה with no verb; 'inti' with a nominal predicate supplied.

notes.subject: għassa
notes.rationale: משמרת = 'something kept/guarded, a charge'; 'għassa' keeps the guard-noun shape rather than 'you will be safe'.

notes.subject: יבקש ... יבקש
notes.rationale: repetition: 'seeks my life — seeks your life', parallelism preserved by repeated 'ifittex'.

notes.subject: ħajja
notes.rationale: נפש = throat/life-force; rendered 'ħajja' (life) since it is the life being sought.

notes.subject: David to Avjatar
notes.rationale: imperatives 'Oqgħod ... tibżax' summon Avjatar to stay under protection.

notes.subject: to Avjatar
notes.rationale: direct second-person address with promise of protection.

translation: Oqgħod miegħi, tibżax, għaliex min ifittex ⟨את⟩ il-ħajja tiegħi, ifittex ⟨את⟩ il-ħajja tiegħek, għaliex inti għassa miegħi.
